meta.title: 1962 Canadian BCP, citation normalization map
meta.description: Book-name aliases and psalm-part rules used to normalize 1962 citations for the app's scripture loaders. The raw citation is always kept alongside the normalized form.

sources.ref: The Book of Common Prayer (1962), The Table of Lessons and Proper Psalms
sources.note: Alias targets are the book ids used by the app's KJV and KJVA corpora.

endKeyword.strategy: replace with the last verse of the loaded chapter, keep raw citation on failure
